'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Jeffrey Johns LS Endor: Back Door''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Back Door|Endor-L-endorbackdoor.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
